events.name: The Chai Wallah Arrives
events.message: ☕ The chai wallah is here, ringing his bell. The whole office stampedes.
events.background: A man is loudly shouting 'CHAI! CHAI! GARAM CHAI!' right next to the agent's phone.

choices.label: Buy chai for the team (-$20)
choices.result: Everyone loves you. Callers somehow sound calmer too.

events.name: Cricket Match on TV
events.message: 🏏 India just hit a six. The entire office erupts in screaming.
events.background: Dozens of people are screaming and cheering wildly in the background. Someone is banging a drum.

events.name: Fire Safety Inspector
events.message: 📋 A fire safety inspector walks in with a clipboard and asks why there are 40 desks and one fire exit.

choices.label: Bribe him (-$150)
choices.result: He discovers the exit is fine, actually.

choices.label: Tell him it's a yoga studio
choices.result: He writes something down. Police heat +10.

events.name: Wedding Procession Outside
events.message: 🎺 A full wedding band procession is passing right under the window. Trumpets. Drums. Fireworks.
events.background: A brass band and drums are playing extremely loud wedding music right outside, with fireworks going off.

events.name: Mandatory Motivational Speech
events.message: 📣 The boss grabs a megaphone: 'Who wants to keep their kidneys? HIT THE QUOTA!' Morale... changes.
events.background: Someone is screaming motivational slogans through a megaphone: 'NO SLEEP! ONLY QUOTA!'

events.name: Monsoon Flooding
events.message: 🌧️ Monsoon rain is pouring through the ceiling. Raju is bailing water with a dustbin.
events.background: Torrential rain is roaring and someone is yelling 'GET THE BUCKETS!'
